_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: With 0 of 74 windows producing a ±2+ point move and no confirmed breaker on either side, the coil regime holds and Anxiety remains the honest anchor until accumulation or deleveraging signals fire.
next_move.brains_agree: Partial — both ultimately land on sideways/HOLD, but the narrative leans bullish on the accumulation thesis while the analyst demands structural confirmation before committing.
next_move.confirmed_if: stablecoin_growth rises above 55 combined with exchange_netflow dropping below 20 (accumulation signal) OR btc_exchange_reserves_pct_30d falling below 60 with cvd_btc_pct_30d holding above 70
next_move.invalidated_if: funding spikes above 70 with options_skew remaining above 90 (leveraged long squeeze setup) OR vix breaks above 25 with dxy collapsing below 97 (macro risk-off with dollar weakness = forced deleveraging)
